Package com.bloomreach.forge.versionhistory.core

Class AbstractContentHistoryTask

java.lang.Object
com.bloomreach.forge.versionhistory.core.AbstractContentHistoryTask
Direct Known Subclasses:
DocumentHistoryCleanerTask, DocumentHistoryTruncaterTask
public abstract class AbstractContentHistoryTask extends Object
Abstract content history management task.

Note: Any tasks extending this are not thread-safe. Therefore, you should keep the lifecycle of tasks in the same thread execution cycle. e.g, in a function.
